description: Reading an int-backed enum's select value with Number(value) fails tsc, because any number isn't one of the enum's values: look it up with selectedKey(enumValues.IssuePriority, value) instead.

expect.errorContains: resources/js/lib/enum-selects.ts(5,5): error TS2322: Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'IssuePriority'.
